svg.aria-label: Falconet ArtVee on four split track pods, in Vehicle Mode, converting, and in Siege Mode, from the side and from above

g.text: Fights as a line tank. Four track pods tucked in, turret turning, combo gun on its autocannon breech.
One full turn. Engine power goes to the conversion gear. The tank cannot move or fire.
Locked down on all four corners as a Thumper battery. The turret still fires in any direction.
Pods and knees form an X
